name: Separate mentions from independent customers
query: Synthesize this feedback in chat: https://notion.so/feedback. Compare enterprise admins and individual users, count distinct customers where supported, and preserve important exceptions.

sources.https://notion.so/feedback: Selected interview and support set, not a representative customer survey. Sources: https://notion.so/f1, https://notion.so/f2, https://notion.so/f3, https://notion.so/f4, https://notion.so/f5, https://notion.so/f6
sources.https://notion.so/f1: Original interview I1, customer A, enterprise admin: requires mandatory approval before export.
sources.https://notion.so/f2: Copied summary of interview I1 from customer A: requires approval before export.
sources.https://notion.so/f3: Separate ticket T1, customer A, enterprise admin: repeats the request for approval before export.
sources.https://notion.so/f4: Interview I2, customer B, enterprise admin: wants mandatory export approval.
sources.https://notion.so/f5: Interview I3, customer C, individual user: mandatory approval would block their solo workflow.
sources.https://notion.so/f6: Interview I4, customer D, enterprise admin: approvals are unnecessary for their sandbox exports; asks for an exception path.

success_criteria: Counts approval demand as two distinct customers, not four; distinguishes the copied summary from A’s separate repeated signal.
Identifies four known distinct customers in the supplied set if presenting a population count.
Preserves the enterprise versus individual difference and D’s enterprise counterexample rather than claiming all admins agree.
Links themes to source feedback, separates suggested implications from observed evidence, and does not infer market prevalence.
Returns a chat synthesis without saving, creating tasks, or messaging customers.
